summary: 2026 UCI WorldTeam kit by Gobik, sold as 'REACTIVE Netcompany INEOS 26'. The team began the season as INEOS Grenadiers and rebranded to the Netcompany INEOS Cycling Team from the 2026 Giro d'Italia (May 2026), when Netcompany joined INEOS as co-title sponsor; this is the kit in use since. 'Netcompany / INEOS' is across the chest and the upper back, with Netcompany also down the sleeves and on a side-panel tab; TotalEnergies fills the band below them on the chest and back and sits on both sleeves; big INEOS letters run down both sleeves and both shorts' thighs, with 'GRENADIER' (the INEOS Grenadier vehicle brand) on the leg hems; 'wtw' is on the left sleeve; Café de Colombia is on the seat of the bib shorts; kit maker Gobik and bike brand Pinarello mark the chest, shorts and back. The small 'UCI WORLD TEAM' marks and the orange diamond '1' badge at the collar and cuffs are category or award marks, not sponsors. Marked complete: the kit maker's full set of photos (front, back, both sides, collar and sleeve close-ups) shows no other sponsor.
